details: Evidence check. parent_company 'Bharti Airtel' → 'Airtel Africa plc': Airtel (Seychelles) Limited is a 100% subsidiary in Airtel Africa plc's accounts; Bharti Airtel is two levels up. parent_hq_country 'IND' → 'GBR': Airtel Africa plc reports under the UK Companies Act. major_shareholders rewritten: the current register gives Bharti Airtel 79.42%, not 62.33%, and no longer lists Warburg Pincus or GIC. foreign_ownership_pct rewritten: the field is the owning entity's foreign share, and the operator is a wholly owned subsidiary; the old figure was Airtel Africa plc's non-Indian float. control_mechanisms rewritten: the stake is 79.42% on the current register, not ~62%. recent_investments rewritten: the Lagos and Nairobi builds are other facilities, and BusinessDay puts Lagos's go-live at 2028, not 2026. dfi_involvement rewritten: neither loan reaches Seychelles, BII has exited, and no source gives the 2025 Kenya/Rwanda $100M. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. key_tenants 'Airtel Seychelles subscribers; Enterprise; Government' → 'Airtel Seychelles (its own network core)': no tenant is named; the only confirmed occupant is Airtel's own core network. govt_data_hosted 'No government data' → 'Unknown': no source addresses government hosting. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: Nxtra's hopes of hyperscale tenants concern its Lagos and Nairobi builds; nothing links a hyperscaler to this facility. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_aws 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. chinese_involvement 'Ownership' → 'None identified': no source names a Chinese party; Ericsson built and fitted the facility. chinese_entities 'Huawei|ZTE' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. cloud_platform rewritten: Ericsson's release describes the platform. open_source_stack 'Mixed open source and proprietary' → 'Unknown': no source describes the software stack. data_residency_guarantee 'Yes, contractual guarantee' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'No claim' → 'Unknown': no source addresses data protection compliance. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': no source addresses IXP connection.
cloud_act_exposure is now set by its rule: Yes for a US parent, Partial for a US hyperscaler service on site, otherwise No. 192 of 377 rows changed value; the rest were relabelled only.
raw_slugs filled for 194 facilities: 138 of their source URLs are in the catalogue. Linkage only; no fact changed.
